subject: Join URL removed after calendar edit — provisioning temporary Zoom and updating invite
messages:
From: Jared Li <jared.li@acmecloud.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: scheduling@acmecloud.com
Date: 2025-11-12T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Can't join demo — invite link gone

Hi Kimberly,

We were trying to join the 11:30 demo but the Join link in the calendar invite resolves to a 404 / 'link not found' page and none of the attendees can get in.

I attached a screenshot of the error. The original invite (from our side) shows a Meet link; looks like our admin pushed a calendar update earlier which may have stripped a token. Can you resend a working join URL? We're on a tight timeline and have ~12 people joining.

Attaching: screenshot-join-404.png, acme-original.ics

Thanks — Jared
Jared Li
Platform Ops, Acme Cloud
jared.li@acmecloud.com

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jared Li <jared.li@acmecloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Can't join demo — invite link gone

Hi Jared — thanks for the heads up and the screenshots.

We saw the same 404 when testing the original Meet link — likely an organizer token got stripped when the invite was edited. To avoid more last-minute access problems, Ben is going to provision a temporary Zoom meeting and push a new ICS to everyone. That will include a dial-in fallback and a short passcode (SSO guests should be able to join without changing their org settings).

Plan: 
- Ben will create a Zoom with a passcode and attach a new .ics to a calendar update (we'll set you and your scheduling address as attendees).
- If anyone still can't join, we'll open a browser-based WebEx fall-back link as a last resort.

Ben/Marissa — can one of you create the Zoom now and send the updated invite to Jared and scheduling@acmecloud.com? Please include the ICS file and flag the update as important so it propagates to Outlook/GCal.

Kimberly Park
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jared Li <jared.li@acmecloud.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com

Date: 2025-11-12T09:24:00-08:00

Hi all — temporary Zoom created and ICS attached.

Zoom meeting: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Passcode: Redwood2025
Dial-in (US): +1 415 555 1234
Meeting ID: 987 654 3210

I've attached redwood-temp-zoom.ics and sent a calendar update to all participants (including scheduling@acmecloud.com). Note: I set the meeting host to Ben Carter (redwood) so we control admissions; Kimberly will reassign if we want to hand ownership back after the demo.

Quick notes: 
- SSO domain users should still be able to join — Zoom SSO is enabled for redwood and should permit external guests.
- If any attendee gets prompted for a sign-in, ask them to use the 'Join as guest' option or call the dial-in number.

If anyone on the Acme side still sees a broken link after the update, reply-all and I'll jump on the call to admit people.

Attachments: redwood-temp-zoom.ics

Thanks Ben — I just accepted the updated calendar event and the Zoom link works for our team. Everyone's confirmed the dial-in as a fallback.

Two quick asks before the call: 
1) Can you update the calendar event description to include the meeting ID and dial-in so our mobile users don't need to open the invite to find it? (Some corporate mobile clients hide the body.)
2) Please do not auto-record without permission — if you plan to record for notes, loop me in so we can confirm with execs.

Appreciate the quick turn-around. See you at 11:30.

— Jared
